messages:
incident-bot: PAGE -> @sarah_oncall: P99 streaming latency breach detected for model gpt-large-int8-v2 in us-west-2, p99=1.45s (SLO 0.9s). Potential calibration/precision change correlated with deploy at 09:00Z. Alerts: latency-slo, streaming-stalls, quant-calib.

sarah_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing dashboards and timeline. does anyone have recent rollout notes for int8-v2? @mike_r?

mike_r: we started a staged calibration push at 08:55Z to int8-v2 with holdback policy = 10%. Canary looked OK in eu-west, but us-west saw higher variance. I left a note in #eng-runtime about a potential kv-cache eviction pattern.

anya_eng: seeing streaming stalls correlated with KV miss rate surge on node pool gp2-usw. p95 jumped and streaming responses aborted mid-chunk. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/streams?model=gpt-large-int8-v2&region=us-west-2

lee_ops: logs show repeated dequant errors around 09:02:
```
2026-03-15T09:02:11.321Z node-23 kernel: dequantize: failed to map block index 4387
2026-03-15T09:02:11.322Z runtime: kv_cache_miss spike: 2987/s
2026-03-15T09:02:11.324Z stream: aborting chunk write ctx=call-7a3f status=deadline_exceeded
```

olivia_se: customer impact quick check: top 3 affected tenants by error rate are: acmecorp (high), partner-lex (medium), free-trial cohort (low). Acme has real-time chat; they may see truncation. I'll open a support tag and notify account team.

jordan_escalations: @sarah_oncall please advise whether to escalate to PagerDuty P1. If Acme is impacted at scale we go P1.

sarah_oncall: Not P1 yet. Triage first. Mitigation plan: 1) stop int8-v2 calibration rollouts (holdbacks) 2) route new streaming traffic to fallback fp16 variant for the model 3) increase node pool concurrency to drain queued requests 4) collect heap/kv metrics for nodes with highest p99. Who can execute step 1-2 quickly?

mike_r: I'll pause the calibration jobs now. running: kubectl patch cm rollout-config -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/int8_v2/active","value":false}]'

anya_eng: executing traffic shift to fallback. Curl to control-plane:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/router/shift" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","from":"int8-v2","to":"fp16-stable","percent":100, "region":"us-west-2"}'
```
shift started at 09:06Z - monitoring impact.

lee_ops: scaling up node pool: autoscaler bumped from 8->14 nodes to reduce queuing. kube events show pods spinning up, expected readiness ~45s.

incident-bot: NOTE: routing-change event recorded (id=evt-2650001234-rc).

olivia_se: I've notified Acme CSM + posted to their status page: "We are investigating elevated streaming latency affecting real-time chat; mitigation in progress."

mike_r: after pausing calibration, early signals: kv-miss rate dropping on nodes where calibration stopped. Example: node-23 kv-miss 2987/s -> 420/s at 09:09Z. p99 on that node dropped from 1.45s -> 0.85s.

anya_eng: streaming stalls count reduced from 42/min -> 6/min post-traffic-shift. still seeing tail spikes on 3 pods with older kernel drivers. collecting core dumps and perf traces.

lee_ops: grabbing a per-pod KV cache heatmap. suspecting a race where int8 dequantized cache entries exceed eviction threshold due to smaller quant buckets causing more frequent misses under certain prompt shapes.

olivia_se: Acme reports intermittent message truncation resolved for now but request follow-up root cause and timeline. Escalation channel opened with their on-call.

jordan_escalations: Recommend we open a customer-facing RCA if root cause ties to our calibration process. tagging for postmortem.

sarah_oncall: current status: mitigation success, traffic fully shifted to fp16-stable, autoscaled nodes healthy. collecting artifacts for RCA. next actions: 1) hold calibration rollouts until thorough sim tests on us-west workload shapes 2) create a canary that simulates long streaming tokens/prefix churn 3) run quantization calibration with KV-size guardrail to prevent eviction storm 4) schedule postmortem with eng-runtime and applied-ml.

mike_r: agree. I'll freeze the int8-v2 tag in the model catalog and add a flag to gate calibration when kv_cache_evictions > 500/s for >30s.

anya_eng: saved traces + core dumps -> s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/2650001234/ ; perf report attached.

lee_ops: marking incident as mitigated at 09:20Z. leaving monitoring on for 2h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=sev-2, impacted_customers=["acmecorp","partner-lex"], postmortem=true.

olivia_se: I'll coordinate communication: brief for Acme + customer follow-up doc. Jordan, can you own the RCA doc with eng-runtime?

jordan_escalations: on it. I'll include timeline, metrics, and mitigations. proposed RCA sections: timeline, deploy notes, telemetry, root cause hypothesis (calib->kv-eviction cascade), remediation, action items.

sarah_oncall: thanks team. I'll handoff to follow-up owners. If any regression or re-spike, re-page immediately. :thumbsup:

olivia_se: closing support ticket as "mitigation in place - under RCA" and informing account team.

mike_r: follow-ups created: DOC-1254 (canary sim), INFRA-992 (kv eviction guard), MODEL-768 (freeze & audit int8-v2).

incident-bot: Thread closed for oncall handoff. Archive in 48h."
